name: Trap

parts.sound: 808 trap kit, crisp clap, hard kick, rolling hats

parts.write: write_bass kick (follows the kick), register 26-43; saturate it

parts.sound: bell, pluck, dark piano, flute, choir
parts.write: write_melody riff or hook in a high register, density 0.6
write_chords voicing spread, rhythm held, -6 dB under the lead
transition riser into the hook, impact on its downbeat

notes: The 808 is the bass: its root on the song's chord, on the kick, held to the next hit. Never a kick and an 808 a few ticks apart.
Hats at half time feel: eighths with 32nd rolls at bar ends.
The melody is a short, dark loop: 2 bars, minor, in a high register clear of the 808.
Big sub, mono; drums and 808 loudest, melody under them.
